description.value: Halston Pub & Liquor Store is a combined neighbourhood pub and off-sale liquor retailer in Kamloops, BC. The dual format means touring cyclists can grab a meal or drink on-site and stock up on take-home beverages in one stop. Its commercial building footprint suggests a full-service venue rather than a kiosk or pop-up.
